title: The daily tape · 18 August 2026
lede: Weekday briefing: country conversion signals already on The Wire, and today's display prints from The Silicon Tape. Display prices are labeled terms. prev_usd and delta stay empty unless a second dated sourced print already sits in the repo. This is not a 7-day move sheet.

countries.name: United States
countries.note: NVIDIA 8-K (17 Aug 2026): residual-value guaranties on PORTS-Pike, ~4.25 IT-GW, OpenAI 20-year lease. Conversion as land-power-shell finance. Source: SEC.

countries.name: India
countries.note: L&T × Together AI (13 Aug 2026): 10,000 B300s at Chennai; Phase 1 sized at 250 MW. Source: The Hindu Business Line / Reuters.

countries.name: Armenia
countries.note: Firebird Hrazdan factory live (8 Aug 2026): NVIDIA/Dell, roadmap 70k+ GPUs and 300 MW by end-2027. Source: NVIDIA blog.

countries.name: Indonesia
